Welcome to Wrestling 2X, the original, most authentic wrestling experience (until WrestlingX came out) on Roblox!

[ FEATURES ]
- Create An Wrestler, including your own Entrance & Moveset!
- Exhibition, win championships and main events!
- Performance Center, get some practice in!
- Create A Federation, make the next WWE, AEW, or your own!

🌟 Credits 🌟
Thanks to the community for continuously providing animations after launch!

scripts.features:
This contains multiple scripts for the game (most for Peformance Center)

Press Play on the Main-Menu > Peformance Center > Join a server shown in the Servers List

Features:
- Rent all Rings
- Spawn Bots
- Spawn Kill Part on Rented Ring Floors
- Change Length time to 15 hours instead of 15 minutes

Anyways if you want a better script for something Roblox Wrestling related (which is better then this game) check the scripts on my profile!
